name: Hosted Agents — dynamic gateway
summary: Same as hosted-agents-static but routes through the dynamic-discovery APIM connection.
description: `project.beta.agents.create_version_from_code(...)` can remote-build an Invocations-protocol Hosted Agent whose container calls `responses.create(model='{dynamic-connection}/{deployment}', ...)`. This exercises dynamic-discovery AI Gateway routing from inside a customer-hosted agent runtime.
notes:
Verified on the wire via the hosted-agent canary's dynamic-discovery probe. See `hosted-agents-canary` for the concrete proof and `test.py` for the remote-build variant.

The canary uses `BYOM_MODEL_DYNAMIC` and reports `responses-openai-dynamic` as `ok:true`. This card keeps the inline `remote_build` path, where Foundry builds the container from an inline zip; that path is slower and cold-start-flaky.
